title: Spanish numbers, days & dates
examples: How do I say the date today in Spanish?
What is the word for 'twenty' in Spanish?
Can you help me say a full date?

explain.say: Today we are learning Spanish numbers from zero to one hundred.
Next we will learn the names of the days of the week.
Then we learn the months of the year in Spanish.
To say the date we use the numbers, the month, and the word 'de'.
For example today is the twenty-fifth of October.
In real life you can say your birthday in Spanish.

items: My birthday is the tenth of May.
It is the twenty-first of December.

faq.q: How do I say the number twenty?
faq.a: You say veinte. It is a simple word to remember.
asks: How do I write 20 in Spanish?

faq.q: Do I need to change the month name?
faq.a: No, you just say the number for the day and then the month name.
asks: Does the month change its spelling?
Is there a rule for the month names?

faq.q: What word do I use between the day and the month?
faq.a: You use the word 'de', which means 'of' in English.
asks: What connects the day and the month?

faq.q: Are the days of the week always capitalized?
faq.a: Yes, the days of the week are always capitalized in Spanish writing.

faq.q: If I say the date, do I say the year too?
faq.a: For a simple date, you only need the day and the month. You can add the year if needed.
asks: Do I need the year for a date?
How do I include the year?

facts: The word for 'day' is 'día', and 'week' is 'semana'.
The word 'de' is used to mean 'of' when stating a date.
The months in Spanish are mostly based on Latin roots.
The days of the week are Lunes, Martes, Miércoles, Jueves, Viernes, Sábado, and Domingo.

quiz.say: If today is the fifth of March, what is the correct Spanish way to say it?
quiz.why: The structure is number, then 'de', then the month name.

wrong.0: This puts the month before the number, which is incorrect.
wrong.1: You should use the word 'de' instead of 'en'.
wrong.2: The number always comes first in this structure.

quiz.say: What is the Spanish word for 'Saturday'?
quiz.why: Sábado is the correct spelling and word for Saturday.

wrong.0: This changes the vowel sounds in the word.
wrong.2: This spelling is missing the accent mark on the 'a'.
wrong.3: This adds an extra letter that is not in the word.

quiz.say: To say the date twenty-two of November, what is the correct sequence?
quiz.why: It follows the pattern: number for the day, then 'de', then the month.

wrong.0: You only need one 'de' and it should be placed correctly.
wrong.1: The preposition used for dates is 'de', not 'en'.
wrong.3: The month should not come before the day number.
